proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C hA hC
  have e := EuclideanGeometry.law_cos A B C
  rw [dist_comm C B] at e
  have p1 : 0 < dist A B := dist_pos.mpr hA
  have p2 : 0 < dist B C := by rw [dist_comm]; exact dist_pos.mpr hC
  have pp : 0 < 2 * dist A B * dist B C := by positivity
  have nn := EuclideanGeometry.angle_nonneg A B C
  have le := EuclideanGeometry.angle_le_pi A B C
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  constructor
  · constructor
    · intro h
      have hc : 0 < Real.cos (EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C) :=
        Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by linarith, h⟩
      nlinarith [mul_pos pp hc]
    · intro h
      by_contra hn
      have hc : Real.cos (EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C) ≤ 0 :=
        Real.cos_nonpos_of_pi_div_two_le_of_le (not_lt.mp hn) (by linarith)
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg pp.le (neg_nonneg.mpr hc)]
  · constructor
    · intro h
      have hc : Real.cos (EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C) < 0 :=
        Real.cos_neg_of_pi_div_two_lt_of_lt h (by linarith)
      nlinarith [mul_pos pp (neg_pos.mpr hc)]
    · intro h
      by_contra hn
      have hc : 0 ≤ Real.cos (EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C) :=
        Real.cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc ⟨by linarith, not_lt.mp hn⟩
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg pp.le hc]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C : P), A ≠ B → C ≠ B → (EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C < Real.pi / 2 ↔ dist A C ^ 2 < dist A B ^ 2 + dist B C ^ 2) ∧ (Real.pi / 2 < EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C ↔ dist A B ^ 2 + dist B C ^ 2 < dist A C ^ 2)
